name: graphql-errors-internal — HTTP 200 + errors[INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR] → UPSTREAM_5XX RETRYABLE (C13)
$comment: EK DEĞER (C13): GraphQL HTTP 200 + errors[INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR] → UPSTREAM_5XX (retryable=true). UNAUTHENTICATED ile karşıtlık: AYNI HTTP 200, farklı extensions.code → farklı retryability. 7.1.4 backoff ile retry eder. Sentetik (FR-TST-008).
